The '''KX9 laser cannon''' was a powerful laser cannon produced by the [[Taim & Bak/Legends|Taim & Bak]] weapons company and could operate both in and out of space. They were considerably more powerful than those on the various [[TIE series/Legends|TIE]] models.

==Description==
[[File:StayOnTarget-TCG.png|thumb|left|220px|An X-wing firing all four KX9 lasers]]
The KX9 was a model of [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannon]] manufactured by [[Taim & Bak/Legends|Taim & Bak]]. Four of these cannons were installed on [[Incom Corporation/Legends|Incom Corporation's]] [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65]] [[X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing starfighter]]. Each laser was mounted at the end of one of the fighter's [[S-foils/Legends|S-foils]]. The lasers could be fire-linked, discharging simultaneously or in alternating pairs.<ref name="EGWT" /> Located near the [[Laser tip/Legends|tip]] of the KX9 was a [[Magnetic flashback suppressor/Legends|magnetic flashback suppressor]], which stopped any overcharged blasts from damaging the cannon.<ref name="NEGWT" /> 

The [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] interfaced with the lasers through a [[Fabritech/Legends|Fabritech]] [[ANq 3.6 sensor computer/Legends|ANq 3.6 tracking computer]] with was linked to an [[IN-344-B "Sightline" holographic imaging system/Legends|IN-344-B "Sightline" holographic imaging system]].<ref name="EGWT" />

==History==
The [[Taim & Bak/Legends|Taim & Bak]] KX9 laser cannons saw action in several notable battles during the [[Rise of the Empire era]] and the [[Rebellion era]] because of their involvement with popular military vehicles.

The KX9's were present at the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] onboard the [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65 X-wings]], which were instrumental in the success of the Rebels.

The laser cannons appeared again during the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]] on the [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65's]], which were escorting the rebel transports past the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial fleet]] and the [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|AT-AT's]] which were assaulting the [[Echo Base/Legends|Rebel ground base]].

They were also involved in the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]] on the [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing's]], which assaulted the incomplete [[Death Star II/Legends|second Death Star]].
